about: Closing years of the spaces on the atlas. An entry comes from the record's own text (it names the `field`) or from a page outside it (it gives `source`, the page's address, and `basis`: press or own site); never from a guess. In both cases the text says the space closed for good, or has been closed since a date with no reopening on record, and names the year. A closure for renovation, a strike, a season or a closed branch is not entered. year_closed is null when the text says the space closed and gives no year. `last_seen` is kept apart: the year of the latest dated activity a search found where no page says the space closed. It is not a closing year and the map never draws it as one. `entity_ended` is for the year a register says the legal body ended, entered only when the space's own papers name that company or charity number; a register search by name is not enough (28 Nov 2026: Companies House lists dissolved companies named Primary Ltd, Spike Island Limited and The Hepworth Wakefield Trust while all three spaces are running). tools/attach_closures.py writes all of it into institutions.json.
